verdict.rationale: Greptile documents API-key authentication via GREPTILE_API_KEY for CLI/CI use, and OAuth for connecting agents to its MCP server. That gives agents their own credentials, but nothing shows those credentials can be scoped or limited to least privilege. Missing for 10: documented per-key scopes or permission restrictions, per-agent or per-repo credential scoping, key management (creation, rotation, revocation) docs, and independent corroboration.
